card.name: Sofa
card.profile: Sofa is a traditional Mandinka warrior dance named for the sofa — the slave-soldiers and cavalry guardians of the Mali Empire and later Bamana and Wassoulou states. Documented by Ofosuwa M. Abiola in History Dances (Routledge, 2019), the dance encodes history through movement; Abiola situates Sofa within Mandinka cultural decolonization, tied to Fodeba Keita and Sekou Toure’s nationalist project. Performed within the Mande drum tradition led by the sabaro/kutiro ensemble.
card.insight: Abiola’s History Dances (2019) argues such dances "can be used as an African-derived primary source for writing African history." (Routledge)
